title: Context overflow during start_run caused mid-run conversation summarization
description: The start_run tool returned a 270,790-character result that exceeded context capacity, causing the conversation to be summarized and resumed in a new context window. Run state (run_id, emittedSignals, phase position) had to be reconstructed from the summary. Had the summary omitted or misrepresented any value, the run could have continued incorrectly.
proposed_resolution: Stream or paginate large start_run results, or persist run state incrementally so that a mid-run context overflow is recoverable from durable storage rather than summary reconstruction.
